subject: Console + API onboarding: timeline, preflight tasks, and timezone slots
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@finpulse.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@finpulse.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Kickoff + console/API training for FinPulse

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team is ready to move to a hands-on onboarding. We want a 90-120 minute session that covers: console walkthrough (admin + billing views), API key creation & scoped keys, and a short live-coding exercise to call embeddings + generation.

Two asks:
- Can you share a preflight checklist so our infra team can open any firewall rules?
- We are in ET (US Eastern). Best days for us next week are Tue/Wed afternoons.

If we can get a slot confirmed and a simple runbook, that will let us invite our security folks.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Cho
Head of Integrations | FinPulse
alex.cho@finpulse.com
+1 (415) 555-0131

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@finpulse.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + console/API training for FinPulse

Hi Alex — great to hear you're ready to move forward.

Attached is a lean preflight checklist (PDF) and a small sample integration YAML you can share with your infra team. High level: we only need outbound HTTPS to our API endpoints, port 443, and the ability to reach the following hostnames (listed in the checklist). If your security team prefers IP allowlists, we can provide ranges in the pre-call.

Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue 2027-06-29, 1:00–3:00pm ET (preferred)
- Wed 2027-06-30, 11:00am–1:00pm ET
- Thu 2027-07-01, 2:00–4:00pm ET (backup)

Agenda draft: 5–10m intros, 30–40m console admin + billing, 30–40m API keys + scoped keys + demo calls, 20–30m live integration / Q&A. Ben will cover the live-coding portion.

I’ll hold the Tue slot tentatively and will wait for confirmation from your side. I also added Samir on the thread — if your security contact needs to join, let us know and we’ll send the runbook early.

Cheers,

—
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com
Attachments: finpulse_preflight_checklist.pdf (PDF, 42KB); sample-integration.yaml (text, 3KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@finpulse.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + console/API training for FinPulse

Hi team — quick note on scope. For the live-coding segment I propose we:
- Walk through creating a scoped API key (read-only embeddings scope + generation scope for dev),
- Run a short notebook that calls embeddings and a completion with streaming enabled,
- Show how to enable prefix/KV caching in the console and how that shows up in the token-level cost dashboard.

Also, if FinPulse wants us to hit their staging environment (they mentioned an internal orchestration), bring the staging URL into the sample YAML so we can demo end-to-end. If not, we’ll use a sandbox account and swap keys at the end.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference.com
+1 (646) 555-0199

From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@finpulse.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@finpulse.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + console/API training for FinPulse

Thanks everyone — confirming Tue 2027-06-29, 1:00–3:00pm ET. I’ve accepted the calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finpulse_console_onboard_20270629

Samir from our infra team will join and validated the checklist; he asked if you can provide an IP range as well — Samir, can you share which firewall appliance you’re running?

We’ll plan to use our staging URL for the live step; I’ve added the staging endpoint in the Drive folder you shared. Please send any short pre-reads and we’ll forward them to security.

See you Tuesday — looking forward to the walkthrough.

—
Alex
Alex Cho | FinPulse
alex.cho@finpulse.com
